== Source scope and standings ==

The event summary uses the complete participant report linked from [[2008 Quebec Provincial Championship]]. Its heading identifies the Quebec Provincial Championship, cube draft, 24 May 2008; the body names Le Chevalier, eight players and the match records. The post was published on 27 May 2008. The earlier cached transcription stopped at 4,000 characters; the recovered post contains 9,438 characters.

The results section summarizes the published match records, not a complete ordered standings list. Four players share a 2-2 record; no tie-break places have been assigned. The author's published handle is trooper shark; no legal name or municipality has been supplied. The source's first-person 4-0 report has not been turned into a separately verified official winner designation. This initial event summary does not transcribe the full report or expand abbreviated participant names.

== Named participants ==

The report explicitly says "Patrick Choquette is 3-1" and names Patrick Choquette as the opponent in its first game.<ref name="report">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303824 Trooper Shark's Quebec Provincial Championship tourney repor], trooper shark, Players Committee Forums (27 May 2008).</ref> The participant links use the full names in that report. The table's eight-player record distribution is unchanged. The author handle and the shorter labels Nic, Frank and Mat remain as reported, without surname expansions. These match records have not been converted into numbered placings.
